attempts.summary: Set up an rsync-over-SSH pull sync of /etc/inventory/app.conf from node1 (source of truth) to node2, scheduled every 5 minutes via cron on node2 (well under the 15-minute requirement). Created the file on node1 (it did not pre-exist), established passwordless SSH from node2 to node1 using the cluster keypair (fixing a missing sshd host-keys/ /run/sshd startup issue on node1, persisted via a tmpfiles.d entry), wrote the sync script, and verified propagation by editing the file on node1 and observing node2 pick up the change automatically. Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on both nodes: captured pre-restart boot_id/service/data baselines, rebooted node1 then node2 one at a time, confirmed changed boot_id on each, and verified services (ssh/cron) and data (app.conf, crontab) recovered — including a live end-to-end sync test after node2's reboot proving the cron automation survives a restart.
